name: Verdant Labs Contamination Handler Gloves
description:
Elbow-length gloves made from multi-layered barrier material that resists chemical, biological, and radiological contamination. The outer layer is self-sealing — small punctures close within seconds. A color-change indicator strip along each finger shifts from green to red when the barrier integrity is compromised.

Used in hazmat operations, substrate containment, and illegal pharmaceutical manufacturing. The self-sealing feature means a single pair can survive conditions that would destroy standard protective equipment.
functionality: Chemical/biological/radiological barrier, self-sealing punctures, integrity monitoring
what_it_says: Whatever you're touching would kill you through your skin if these gloves weren't between you and it.
story_hooks: A discarded pair of Contamination Handler gloves tests positive for a substance that doesn't match any known chemical compound — whatever was handled in these gloves hasn't been catalogued yet.
